name: Aldenhoven (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided horizontally yellow over black, with a blue fleur-de-lis on the yellow and a yellow cross within a wreath on the black, the figures of the municipal arms of Aldenhoven.
history: Municipal flag of Aldenhoven; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
